import pandas as pd
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

folder = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/sandbox/moves_xlsx/"

files = [f for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(folder)
         if not f.isDir and f.name.lower().endswith((".csv", ".xlsx"))]
print(f"{len(files)} file(s):", [f.name for f in files])

def read_one(f):
    local = f"/tmp/{f.name}"
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(f.path, f"file:{local}")
    if f.name.lower().endswith(".csv"):
        raw = pd.read_csv(local, header=None, dtype=str, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    else:
        raw = pd.read_excel(local, header=None, dtype=str)
    # header row = first row whose first cell is "Time Completed" (works with or without the logo/title rows)
    hdr = raw.index[raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == "Time Completed"][0]
    pdf = raw.iloc[hdr + 1:].copy()
    pdf.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in raw.iloc[hdr]]
    pdf = pdf.loc[:, [c for c in pdf.columns if c and c != "nan"]].dropna(how="all")
    # normalise timestamps per file (Excel date cells vs "15-Oct-2026 00:01" text)
    ts = pd.to_datetime(pdf["Time Completed"], errors="coerce", dayfirst=True)
    pdf["Time Completed"] = ts.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    pdf["source_file"] = f.name
    return pdf

pdf_all = pd.concat([read_one(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True)
pdf_all.columns = [c.replace(".", "_").replace(" ", "_") for c in pdf_all.columns]
pdf_all = pdf_all.astype(object).where(pdf_all.notna(), None)

schema = ", ".join(f"`{c}` string" for c in pdf_all.columns)
df = spark.createDataFrame(pdf_all, schema=schema)

df = (df.withColumn("Time_Completed", F.to_timestamp("Time_Completed"))
        .withColumn("Dist_Carry", F.col("Dist_Carry").cast("double").cast("int"))
        .withColumn("Dist_Start", F.col("Dist_Start").cast("double").cast("int")))

# drop rows duplicated across overlapping exports
# before = df.count()
# df = df.dropDuplicates([c for c in df.columns if c != "source_file"]).cache()
# after = df.count()
key_cols = ["Unit_Nbr", "Time_Completed", "Event_ID", "From_Position", "To_Position"]

df = df.withColumn(
    "move_key",
    F.sha2(F.concat_ws("||", *[F.coalesce(F.col(c).cast("string"), F.lit("")) for c in key_cols]), 256)
)

before = df.count()
# keep the newest file's copy if an export overlaps
from pyspark.sql import Window
w = Window.partitionBy("move_key").orderBy(F.col("source_file").desc())
df = (df.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
        .filter("rn = 1").drop("rn")
        .cache())
after = df.count()
print(f"Rows: {before} -> {after} ({before - after} duplicates removed)")


# display(df.groupBy("source_file").count())
# print(f"Rows: {before} -> {after} after removing {before - after} duplicates")
# print("Null timestamps:", df.filter(F.col("Time_Completed").isNull()).count())  # should be 0
df.printSchema()
display(df.limit(20))

# LOAD Laden Distance Analysis
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

d = F.to_date("Time_Completed")
isodow = ((F.dayofweek(d) + 5) % 7) + 1
iso_year = F.year(F.date_add(d, 4 - isodow))

INF_LIMIT = 10000
is_inf  = F.col("Dist_Carry") >= INF_LIMIT
is_zero = F.col("Dist_Carry") == 0

summary = (
    df.withColumn("Move_Date", d)
      .withColumn("ISO_Year", iso_year)
      .withColumn("ISO_Week", F.weekofyear("Move_Date"))
      .groupBy("Move_Date", "ISO_Year", "ISO_Week",
               "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID")
      .agg(F.sum("Dist_Carry").alias("Total_Dist_Carry"),
           F.count("*").alias("Move_Count"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_inf, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Infinity_Count"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_inf, F.col("Dist_Carry")).otherwise(0)).alias("Infinity_Sum"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_zero, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Zero_Count"))
      .withColumn("ISO_Week_Label",
                  F.concat(F.col("ISO_Year"), F.lit("-W"), F.lpad(F.col("ISO_Week").cast("string"), 2, "0")))
      .select("Move_Date", "ISO_Week_Label", "ISO_Year", "ISO_Week",
              "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID",
              "Total_Dist_Carry", "Move_Count",
              "Infinity_Count", "Infinity_Sum", "Zero_Count")
      .orderBy("Move_Date", "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID")
)

# Checks: each total must match the raw data
print("Summary rows:", summary.count())
print("Total_Dist_Carry:", summary.agg(F.sum("Total_Dist_Carry")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.agg(F.sum("Dist_Carry")).first()[0])
print("Infinity_Count:", summary.agg(F.sum("Infinity_Count")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.filter(F.col("Dist_Carry") >= INF_LIMIT).count())
print("Zero_Count:", summary.agg(F.sum("Zero_Count")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.filter(F.col("Dist_Carry") == 0).count())

display(summary)

#Decking Storage
import pandas as pd
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F, Window

folder = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/sandbox/deckings_xlsx/"
out    = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/sandbox/deckings_export/deckings_export"

files = [f for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(folder)
         if not f.isDir and f.name.lower().endswith((".csv", ".xlsx"))]
print(f"{len(files)} file(s):", [f.name for f in files])

def read_one(f):
    local = f"/tmp/{f.name}"
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(f.path, f"file:{local}")
    if f.name.lower().endswith(".csv"):
        raw = pd.read_csv(local, header=None, dtype=str, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    else:
        raw = pd.read_excel(local, header=None, dtype=str)
    # header row = first row whose first cell is "Yard Name" (skips logo/title/"Displaying..." rows)
    hdr = raw.index[raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == "Yard Name"][0]
    pdf = raw.iloc[hdr + 1:].copy()
    pdf.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in raw.iloc[hdr]]
    pdf = pdf.loc[:, [c for c in pdf.columns if c and c != "nan"]].dropna(how="all")
    pdf["source_file"] = f.name
    return pdf

pdf_all = pd.concat([read_one(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True)
pdf_all.columns = [c.strip().replace(".", "_").replace(" ", "_") for c in pdf_all.columns]
# expected: Yard_Name, Time, Gkey, Unit_ID, Decking_Type, Node, Container_Last_Pos,
#           To_Pos, Total_Score, Execution_Time, source_file

# drop any trailing footer/blank rows that have no Gkey
pdf_all = pdf_all[pdf_all["Gkey"].notna()]
pdf_all = pdf_all.astype(object).where(pdf_all.notna(), None)

schema = ", ".join(f"`{c}` string" for c in pdf_all.columns)
df = spark.createDataFrame(pdf_all, schema=schema)

# Time looks like "15-Oct-2026 03:14:19 480" -> turn the trailing " 480" into ".480"
t = F.regexp_replace(F.trim("Time"), r"^(\d{2}-\w{3}-\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+(\d{1,3})$", "$1.$2")
df = (df.withColumn("Time", F.coalesce(
                F.to_timestamp(t, "dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS"),
                F.to_timestamp(t, "dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss")))
        .withColumn("Gkey", F.col("Gkey").cast("double").cast("long"))
        .withColumn("Total_Score", F.col("Total_Score").cast("double").cast("int"))
        .withColumn("Execution_Time", F.col("Execution_Time").cast("double").cast("int")))

# Gkey uniquely identifies a decking record; keep newest file's copy if exports overlap
before = df.count()
w = Window.partitionBy("Gkey").orderBy(F.col("source_file").desc())
df = (df.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
        .filter("rn = 1").drop("rn")
        .cache())
after = df.count()
print(f"Rows: {before} -> {after} ({before - after} duplicates removed)")

# sanity check: any timestamps that failed to parse
print("Unparsed Time rows:", df.filter(F.col("Time").isNull()).count())

df.write.mode("overwrite").format("delta").save(out)

#Decking Enriched
from pyspark.sql import functions as F, Window

base     = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/sandbox/"
dh_path  = base + "deckings_export/deckings_export"
mh_path  = base + "moves_export/moves_export"
out_path = base + "deckings_enriched/deckings_enriched"

dh = spark.read.format("delta").load(dh_path).alias("dh")
mh = (spark.read.format("delta").load(mh_path)
        .select("Unit_Nbr", "Time_Completed", "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category")
        .alias("mh"))

cond = (
    (F.col("dh.Unit_ID") == F.col("mh.Unit_Nbr")) &
    (F.col("dh.Time") <= F.col("mh.Time_Completed")) &
    (F.col("mh.Time_Completed") <= F.col("dh.Time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 4 DAYS"))
)

joined = dh.join(mh, cond, "left")

# keep only ONE move per decking: the earliest move after the decking
w = Window.partitionBy("dh.Gkey").orderBy(F.col("mh.Time_Completed").asc_nulls_last())

dh_enriched = (joined
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter("rn = 1").drop("rn")
    .select("dh.*",
            F.col("mh.Unit_Frght_Kind").alias("MoveFrght_Kind"),
            F.col("mh.Unit_Category").alias("Category"),
            F.col("mh.Time_Completed").alias("Matched_Move_Time")))  # optional, handy for validation

# sanity checks
print("DH rows:", dh.count(), "| Enriched rows:", dh_enriched.count())   # must be equal
print("Deckings with a matched move:", dh_enriched.filter("MoveFrght_Kind is not null").count())

dh_enriched.write.mode("overwrite").format("delta").save(out_path)

#Decking Enriched 2
from pyspark.sql import functions as F, Window

base      = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/"
dh_path   = base + "bronze/sandbox/deckings_export/deckings_export"
mh_path   = base + "bronze/sandbox/moves_export/moves_export"
silver_mv = base + "silver/moves"                       # <-- confirm path
out_path  = base + "bronze/sandbox/deckings_enriched/deckings_enriched"

dh = spark.read.format("delta").load(dh_path).alias("dh")

# MH: Unit_Nbr / Time_Completed / Unit_Frght_Kind / Unit_Category
mh = (spark.read.format("delta").load(mh_path)
        .select(F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("Unit_Nbr"),
                F.col("Time_Completed").alias("Move_Time"),
                F.col("Unit_Frght_Kind").alias("MoveFrght_Kind"),
                F.col("Unit_Category").alias("Category"))
        .alias("mh"))

# Silver: Unit_Nbr / t_put / Freight_Kind_Id / Category_Id
sm = (spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_mv)
        .select(F.col("Unit_Nbr").alias("Unit_Nbr"),
                F.col("t_put").cast("timestamp").alias("Move_Time"),
                F.col("Freight_Kind_Id").alias("MoveFrght_Kind"),
                F.col("Category_Id").alias("Category"))
        .alias("m"))

def window_cond(r):   # move happens 0-4 days after the decking
    return ((F.col("dh.Unit_ID") == F.col(f"{r}.Unit_Nbr")) &
            (F.col("dh.Time") < F.col(f"{r}.Move_Time")) &
            (F.col(f"{r}.Move_Time") <= F.col("dh.Time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 4 DAYS")))

def one_per_decking(df, r):   # earliest matching move per Gkey
    w = Window.partitionBy("dh.Gkey").orderBy(F.col(f"{r}.Move_Time").asc_nulls_last())
    return df.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w)).filter("rn = 1").drop("rn")

# 1) MH match
j1 = (one_per_decking(dh.join(mh, window_cond("mh"), "left"), "mh")
        .select("dh.*",
                F.col("mh.MoveFrght_Kind").alias("mh_Frght"),
                F.col("mh.Category").alias("mh_Cat"),
                F.col("mh.Move_Time").alias("mh_Move_Time")))

# 2) silver match (same rule), joined on the MH result
j2 = (one_per_decking(j1.alias("dh").join(sm, window_cond("m"), "left"), "m")
        .select("dh.*",
                F.col("m.MoveFrght_Kind").alias("m_Frght"),
                F.col("m.Category").alias("m_Cat"),
                F.col("m.Move_Time").alias("m_Move_Time")))

# 3) coalesce: MH first, silver as fallback
dh_enriched = (j2
    .withColumn("MoveFrght_Kind", F.coalesce("mh_Frght", "m_Frght"))
    .withColumn("Category",       F.coalesce("mh_Cat",   "m_Cat"))
    .withColumn("Matched_Move_Time", F.coalesce("mh_Move_Time", "m_Move_Time"))
    .withColumn("Enrich_Source",
        F.when(F.col("mh_Frght").isNotNull() | F.col("mh_Cat").isNotNull(), "MH")
         .when(F.col("m_Frght").isNotNull()  | F.col("m_Cat").isNotNull(),  "SILVER")
         .otherwise("NONE"))
    .drop("mh_Frght", "mh_Cat", "m_Frght", "m_Cat", "mh_Move_Time", "m_Move_Time"))

# sanity checks
print("DH rows:", dh.count(), "| Enriched rows:", dh_enriched.count())   # must match
dh_enriched.groupBy("Enrich_Source").count().show()
